logger.doc:name: Log Sync Summary Request
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "Fetching sync summary from database.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

db:select.doc:name: Fetch Sync Summary From Database
db:select.db:sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrders,
SUM( CASE WHEN syncStatus = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS pendingOrders,
SUM( CASE WHEN syncStatus = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS syncedOrders,
SUM( CASE WHEN syncStatus = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS failedOrders
FROM ordersStaging

logger.doc:name: Database Error
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, errorType: "DATABASE_ERROR", errorMessage: error.description, correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: false, message: "Unable to fetch sync summary.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]
set-payload.doc:name: Error Payload

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { totalOrders: payload[0].totalOrders, pendingOrders: payload[0].pendingOrders, syncedOrders: payload[0].syncedOrders, failedOrders: payload[0].failedOrders, correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Sync Summary Response
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "Sync summary response sent successfully.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]
